::: {.statx-chapter-banner}
## Turn relationships into models—and challenge them

This lab will move from a fitted line to multivariable and logistic models, with interpretation and diagnostics at every step.
:::

## Learning objectives

By the end of this lab, students will be able to:

1. Fit simple and multiple linear regression models.
2. Interpret intercepts, slopes, adjusted effects, and interactions in context.
3. Diagnose linearity, equal variance, residual behavior, and influential observations.
4. Evaluate prediction on data not used to fit the model.

## Planned workflow

::: {.statx-topic-grid}
::: {.statx-topic-card}
### 1. Explore the relationship

Use graphics and domain knowledge to propose a meaningful model.
:::

::: {.statx-topic-card}
### 2. Fit and interpret

Translate coefficients and uncertainty into statements about the variables and units.
:::

::: {.statx-topic-card}
### 3. Diagnose

Inspect residual plots and influence measures, then document any limitations.
:::

::: {.statx-topic-card}
### 4. Validate

Compare training and test performance and discuss overfitting.
:::
:::

## Deliverables

- An exploratory plot and model specification
- A coefficient-interpretation table
- A diagnostic figure with commentary
- A short validation report
